import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        long[] input_array = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            input_array[i] = sc.nextLong();
        }
        int window = sc.nextInt();
        int[] freq = new int[1001];
        for (long val : input_array) {
            if (val <= 1000) {
                freq[(int) val]++;
            }
        }
        long[] prefix_sum = new long[1002];
        for (int i = 1; i <= 1000; i++) {
            prefix_sum[i] = prefix_sum[i - 1] + freq[i];
        }
        long max_occurrences = 0;
        for (int i = window; i <= 1000; i++) {
            max_occurrences = Math.max(max_occurrences, prefix_sum[i] - prefix_sum[i - window]);
        }
        System.out.println(max_occurrences);
        sc.close();
    }
}
